Rashi on Ketubot 33a:1:1.hebrew: ופרכינן חובל בחבירו - דעל כרחך בממון נידון, תקשי: בטלת לאו ד"לא יוסיף פן יוסיף", שהוא אזהרה למכה את חבירו:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:1:1.english: And we ask: [With regard to] one who injures another - Since he is perforce judged with monetary [payment], there is a difficulty: you have nullified the negative commandment of "he shall not exceed, lest he exceed," which is a warning to one who strikes his fellow.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:1:2.english: And it shall be if [the wicked man] deserves to be flogged - In Tractate Makkot (2b), we establish it [as referring] to conspiring witnesses.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:1:3.hebrew: אלא - על כרחך, כיון דרבייה קרא לתשלומין, איכא לאוקמא לעונש מלקות דלאו דידיה במעידין אנו את איש פלוני כהן שהוא בן גרושה, דליכא לאוקמי כאשר זמם ולומר יהא הוא בן גרושה תחתיו, אלא סופג את הארבעים — והכי תנן במסכת מכות. וחובל בחבירו נמי מוקמינן ליה בשאין בה שוה פרוטה בכל חמשה דברים שבה: כגון שלא פיחתו מכספו וממלאכתו, וריפוי לא הוצרך, ולא צער היה בה, ובשוטה שאין לה בושת. והכא נמי, באחותו מצית לאוקמי מלקות דידה בבוגרת, אבל נערה לישלם ולא לילקי, הואיל וריבתה גזירה שוה דתחת תחת לתשלומין:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:1:3.english: Rather - Perforce, since the verse included [them] for monetary payment, you can establish the punishment of lashes for its prohibition in [a case where they say], "We testify about so-and-so, a priest, that he is the son of a divorcée," where one cannot apply "as he conspired [to do]" and say, "Let him become the son of a divorcée in his stead"; rather, he receives the forty [lashes] — and so we learned in tractate Makkot. And [regarding] one who injures another as well, we establish it in [a case where] there is not the value of a peruta in all five [categories of] liability in it: for example, where he did not diminish his monetary worth or his labor, and he did not require healing, and there was no pain in it, and [it occurred] to an imbecile, who has no [compensation for] humiliation. And here too, regarding his sister, you can establish her [punishment of] lashes in [the case of] a bogeret [an adult woman], whereas [for] a na'arah [a young maiden], let him pay and not be lashed, since the gezerah shavah [verbal analogy] of tachat, tachat included her for monetary payment.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:2:1.hebrew: לכדאביי - בשילהי פירקין, דפרכינן: "ואימא חמשים אמר רחמנא מכל מילי"? ושני אביי: חמשים כסף נתחדשו תחת קנס העינוי, אבל בושת ופגם, שהוא בשאר חובלים, לא כלל כאן:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:2:1.english: To [that] of Abaye - At the end of our chapter, where we ask: "And say [that] the Merciful One said fifty [shekels] for all things?" And Abaye answered: Fifty silver [coins] were innovated for the fine of the affliction, but humiliation and degradation, which [apply] to other injurers [as well], He did not include here.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:3:1.hebrew: השוכב עמה - קרא יתירא הוא לדרשה, נימא ונתן לאבי הנערה חמשים כסף:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:3:1.english: Who lay with her - It is an extra phrase [in the verse] for exposition; [otherwise] let [Scripture] say, “And he shall give to the father of the young woman fifty [shekels of] silver.”

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:3:2.hebrew: מכלל דבושת ופגם - דלאו מחמת הנאת שכיבה נינהו, שהרי ישנן בשאר חובלים, לא כיילינהו בגוייהו דהני:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:3:2.english: By inference, [there is] humiliation and degradation - For they are not on account of the pleasure of lying [with her], since they apply in [cases of] other injurers; [the verse] did not include them within these [fifty shekels].

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:1.hebrew: רבי אלעזר אומר עדים זוממין דממונא משלמי ולא לקו - לא צריכי קרא, דסברא היא דמלקות לא שייך בהו:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:1.english: Rabbi Elazar says: Conspiring witnesses, that they pay money and are not flogged - They do not need a verse, for it is [a matter of] logical reasoning that lashes do not apply to them.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:2.hebrew: דלאו בני התראה נינהו - קודם עדות, כדמפ' רבא ואזיל. הלכך, אי איכא למענשינהו, לא תענשינהו אלא ממון, דאין עונש הגוף בלא התראה. ואע"ג דגבי בן גרושה ובן חלוצה ענשינן להו מלקות בלא התראה, התם גזירת הכתוב, דאשכחן בהו מלקות בהדיא, "והיה אם בן הכות", ומוקמינן לקרא במידי דלא מצית למענשינהו מ"כאשר זמם"; אבל היכא דמצית למיעבד בהו הזמה, לא שייך בהו מלקות:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:2.english: That they are not subject to forewarning - prior to [their] testimony, as Rava goes on to explain. Therefore, if there is [a way] to punish them, you may only punish them [with] money, for there is no corporal punishment without forewarning. And even though regarding [conspiring witnesses who testify that a priest is] the son of a divorced woman or the son of a chalutzah we punish them [with] lashes without forewarning, there it is a scriptural decree, for we find lashes [stated] explicitly regarding them — "And it shall be, if [he is] deserving of lashes" — and we establish the verse [as referring] to a case where you cannot punish them under [the law of] "as he had plotted [to do]"; but where you can carry out hazamah against them, lashes do not apply to them.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:3.english: Know - that it is impossible to forewarn them.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:4.english: Initially - A day or an hour before they give the testimony.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:5.hebrew: אמרי אישתלין - שכחנו ההתראה, הרי שבטלה ההתראה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:5.english: They say: We forgot - We forgot the forewarning; behold, the forewarning is nullified.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:6.hebrew: פרשי ולא מסהדי - אפילו אמת, הואיל ואנו חשודים בעיניכם, מה לנו ולצרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:6.english: They will withdraw and not testify - Even [if their testimony is] true, [they will say,] "Since we are suspected in your eyes, what have we to do with trouble?"

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:7.english: At the end - After they have testified.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:8.hebrew: מאי דהוה הוה - דכיון שהגיד, אינו חוזר ומגיד, ואינן יכולין לחזור:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:4:8.english: That which was, was - For once [a witness] has testified, he cannot testify again, and they cannot retract [their testimony].

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:5:1.hebrew: וניתרי בהו בתוך כדי דבור - לאחר שהעידו, דתוך כדי דבור כדבור דמי, ויכולים לחזור:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:5:1.english: And let us warn them within [an interval] equivalent to speaking - After they have testified, for [the interval] within [the time] equivalent to speaking is like [continuous] speech, and they are able to retract [their testimony].

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:5:2.english: Within the time of speaking - Equivalent to [the time of] a greeting of peace.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:5:3.hebrew: ונרמז רמוזי - בשעת העדות נרמוז להם רמזים על ההתראה להזכירם, ובלשון רך שלא יקפידו:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:5:3.english: And gesture [to them] - At the time of the testimony, we will give them hints about the warning to remind them, and in gentle language so that they will not take offense.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:6:1.english: That which I stated is not a [valid] matter - [Namely,] that conspiring witnesses should require forewarning.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:6:2.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr> דאינהו בעו למיקטל בלא התראה, ואינהו בעו התראה כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:6:2.english: This is the reading [in the Gemara]: "that they sought to kill without forewarning, and they [themselves] require forewarning, etc."

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:6:3.hebrew: כאשר זמם - והם זממו להרוג את זה בעדותן שלא היה ולא נברא, ולא התרו בו ההתראה שהעידו עליה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:6:3.english: As he conspired - And they conspired to kill this [person] through their testimony [about something] that never happened and never existed, and they did not forewarn him [with] the forewarning about which they testified.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה - דהאי דלא בעו התראה משום "כאשר זמם" הוא, מלקות של זוממי עדות בן גרושה ובן חלוצה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:1.english: However, if [it is] so - [that is,] that this [rule] that they do not require forewarning is because of "as he conspired," [then] the lashes of conspiring witnesses [who gave] testimony [regarding] the son of a divorcée or the son of a ḥalutza [should require forewarning].

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:2.hebrew: דלאו מכאשר זמם אתי - עונש דידהו, שהרי לא זממו להלקותו אלא לחללו:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:2.english: Which does not come from “as he conspired” - [Namely,] their punishment, for they did not conspire to have him lashed, but rather to profane him [from the priesthood].

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:3.hebrew: משפט השוה - וכיון דרוב זוממין לאו בני התראה נינהו, הני נמי לא בעו התראה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:7:3.english: An equal law - And since most conspiring [witnesses] are not subject to forewarning, these too do not require forewarning.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:8:1.english: Of a quarrel that involves death - For he intended to kill him.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:8:2.hebrew: הכתוב מדבר - דכתיב: אם אסון יהיה — שמתה האשה — ונתת נפש, ואע"פ שלא נתכוון אלא לחבירו. ואשמעינן: נתכוון להרוג את זה והרג את זה, חייב:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:8:2.english: The verse is speaking - As it is written: "If any harm follow" — [meaning] that the woman died — "[then] you shall give a soul," even though he only intended [to strike] his fellow; and [this] teaches us [that if] one intended to kill this [person] and killed that [person], he is liable.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:9:1.english: If they did not forewarn him - [Saying,] "If you kill him, you will be executed."

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:9:2.english: With regard to a severe matter - [i.e.,] death.

Rashi on Ketubot 33a:9:3.hebrew: הוי מותרה לדבר הקל - שאם יכנו ולא ימות, ילקה. ואפילו הכי אמר רחמנא דכי אין שם חיוב מיתה, יענש דמי ולדות, ואף על גב דאיכא התראה למלקות; אלמא משלם ואינו לוקה:
Rashi on Ketubot 33a:9:3.english: Is forewarned with regard to a lesser matter - For if he strikes him and he does not die, he is flogged. And even so, the Merciful One states that when there is no liability for death, he shall be punished [with] the value of the offspring, even though there is a forewarning for lashes; evidently, he pays and is not flogged.

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:10:1.hebrew: ממאי דמותרה לדבר חמור הוי מותרה לדבר הקל דלמא לא הוי - אין לומר דטעמא משום דאהריגה הוא דקיבל התראה, דניחא ליה ליהרג על מנת שיהרוג שונאו, ד"תמות נפשי עם פלשתים" הוא דקאמר, אבל לא ניחא ליה להכות את חבירו על מנת שילקוהו; דהא אמתני' דפרק הנשרפין (סנהדרין ד' עט:), דקתני דחייבי מיתות שנתערבו ידונו בקלה, וקאמר בגמ' (שם דף פ:): "ש"מ מותרה לדבר חמור הוי מותרה לדבר הקל", והתם פשיטא דכיון דהתרו בו לסקילה וקבל, כ"ש שאם התרו בו חנק על אותו דבר עצמו שהיה מקבל, ואפ"ה בעי למימר דמותרה לדבר חמור לא הוי מותרה לדבר הקל. אלא יש לומר דגזירת הכתוב הוא, דבעינן שיתיר עצמו לאותה מיתה, בין קלה בין חמורה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:10:1.english: From where [do you ascertain] that one who is forewarned with regard to a severe matter is forewarned with regard to a lesser matter? Perhaps he is not - One cannot say that the reason is that it was for killing that he accepted the warning, because he is willing to be killed in order to kill his enemy — as he is saying, "Let my soul die with the Philistines" [Judges 16:30] — whereas he is not willing to strike his fellow in order to be flogged; for regarding the Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] HaNisrafin (Sanhedrin 79b), which teaches that those liable to [different] death penalties who became intermingled are judged with the more lenient [death penalty], the Gemara says (ibid. 80b): "Learn from this that one who is forewarned with regard to a severe matter is forewarned with regard to a lesser matter," and there it is obvious that since they warned him for stoning and he accepted [it], all the more so if they had warned him for strangulation for that very same act he would have accepted [it], and even so [the Gemara] sought to say that one who is forewarned with regard to a severe matter is not forewarned with regard to a lesser matter. Rather, one must say that it is a scriptural decree that we require that he submit himself to that [specific] death penalty, whether lenient or severe.

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:1:1.hebrew: אלא אפשר לקיומי בבן גרושה או בבן חלוצה - ואם תאמר: אמאי לקו אעדות דבן גרושה? הא הוי עדות שאין אתה יכול להזימה! ויש לומר: דלא חשיב עדות שאין אתה יכול להזימה אלא במעידין על הטרפה, דאי אפשר לקיומי בשום דבר — לא במיתה ולא במלקות — דגברא קטילא בעו למיקטל; אבל הכא נתקיימה הזמה במלקות:
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:1:1.english: Rather, it can be fulfilled in [the case of] the son of a divorcée or the son of a ḥalutza - And if you ask: Why are they flogged for testimony regarding the son of a divorcée? Surely it is testimony that you cannot subject to hazamah [with its reciprocal punishment]! And one can say: It is not considered testimony that you cannot subject to hazamah except when they testify against a tereifah, where it is impossible to fulfill [hazamah] in any way — neither with death nor with lashes — because they sought to kill a person who is [already considered] dead; but here, hazamah is fulfilled through lashes.

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:2:1.hebrew: מיבעי ליה לכדאביי - ואם תאמר: כיון דאיצטריך תחת להך דרשה, א"כ מנא לן מיטב? וי"ל דיליף מנתינה או מכסף:
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:2:1.english: He requires it for that [teaching] of Abaye - And if you will say: Since "tachat" is needed for this exposition, if so, from where do we derive meitav [payment from the best of one's property]? And one can say that it is derived from "giving" or from "silver":

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:3:1.hebrew: ועולא נפקא ליה מדרבא - משמע דרבא סבר כעולא, דרבי יוחנן גופיה הוה דריש כעולא אי לאו משום דמיבעי ליה לכדאביי. וקשה לרשב"א, דבפרק השוכר את הפועלים (ב"מ צא. ושם) משמע בהדיא דסבר כרבי יוחנן גבי חוסם פרה ודש בה לוקה ומשלם, דמוקי לה אביי כרבי מאיר, ורבא אמר: לעולם כרבנן, ואתנן אסרה תורה אפי' בא על אמו — פירוש: ומשלם לצאת ידי שמים; משמע דבדין לוקה ואינו משלם. ולמאי דפרישי' לעיל, דלמסקנא דווקא בהני תלת אית ליה לעולא דממונא משלם ולא לקי, אתי שפיר, דבעלמא סבר כרבי יוחנן דלוקה ואין משלם, כדדריש רבי יוחנן, וסמיך ליה "ארבעים יכנו":
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:3:1.english: And Ulla derives it from Rava - This implies that Rava holds like Ulla, since Rabbi Yochanan himself would have expounded [it] like Ulla were it not that he needed it for Abaye's [teaching]. And [this is] difficult for the Rashba, for in the chapter [entitled] Hasocher Et HaPo'alim (Bava Metzia 91a, and there [in the parallel]), it is explicitly implied that [Rava] holds like Rabbi Yochanan regarding [the case of] one who muzzles a cow and threshes with it [where the Mishnah rules that] he receives lashes and pays: for Abaye establishes it in accordance with Rabbi Meir, whereas Rava says: Actually, [it is] in accordance with the Rabbis, and the Torah forbade a harlot's hire even if one cohabited with his mother — meaning, and he pays [only] to fulfill his obligation toward Heaven; [this] implies that by [strict] law, he receives lashes and does not pay. However, according to what we explained above — that in the conclusion, specifically in these three [cases] Ulla holds that he pays money and does not receive lashes — it works out well, for elsewhere [Rava] holds like Rabbi Yochanan that he receives lashes and does not pay, as Rabbi Yochanan expounds [from the fact that] juxtaposed to it is [the verse], "forty [lashes] he shall strike him."

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:4:1.hebrew: ניתרי בהו מעיקרא כו' - ואם תאמר: תיפוק ליה דהויא התראת ספק, דאין אנו יודעין אם מעידים שקר? ויש לומר: דהתראת ספק לא הויא אלא כגון "אל תותיר", שאף למותרה עצמו הוא ספק, שסבור שעדיין יש שהות ביום; אבל הכא, המותרין יודעין שמעידין שקר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:4:1.english: "Let us forewarn them initially," etc. - And if you will say: Let it be derived [that they cannot be forewarned] because it is an uncertain forewarning, as we do not know whether they are testifying falsely? And one can answer that it is not [considered] an uncertain forewarning except in a case such as "Do not leave over" [sacrificial meat], where even for the one being forewarned himself it is uncertain, as he thinks that there is still time left in the day; however here, those being forewarned know that they are testifying falsely.

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:5:1.hebrew: וניתרי בהו בתוך כדי דבור - ואם תאמר: היכי מצי תו הדרי בהו? והא בהתראה איכא טפי מכדי דבור, שהוא כדי שאילת שלום! ויש לומר דכל זמן שעסוקים באותו דבר, חשיב הכל תוך כדי דבור, כדאמרינן במכות (דף ו.) דאפי' מעידין מאה, כל אחד תוך כדי דבור של חבירו — חשובין כולן תוך כדי דבור של ראשון, ואם נמצא אחד מהן קרוב או פסול, עדותן בטילה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:5:1.english: "And let us warn them within [an interval] equivalent to [the time of] speaking" - And if you ask: How can they still retract [their testimony]? Surely in [delivering] the warning there is more [time] than [an interval] equivalent to speaking, which is [only] the time needed for a greeting! One can answer that as long as they are engaged in that same matter, the entire [period] is considered within [an interval] equivalent to speaking, as we say in Makkot (6a): that even if one hundred [witnesses] testify, each one within [an interval] equivalent to speaking of his fellow — they are all considered within [an interval] equivalent to speaking of the first [witness], and if one of them is found to be a relative or disqualified, their [entire] testimony is void.

Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:9:1.hebrew: אלא פשיטא דאתרו ביה - וא"ת: היכי משלם ממון אפי' כי אין אסון? הא כיון דמתכוין להרוג הוי ליה רודף, ומתחייב בנפשו, וקים ליה בדרבה מיניה! וי"ל: בשיכולין להצילו באחד מאבריו, והכי אמרינן בבן סורר (סנהדרין דף עד.):
Tosafot on Ketubot 33a:9:1.english: "Rather, obviously, they forewarned him" - And if you ask: How does he pay money even when there is no fatality? Since once he intends to kill, he is a pursuer [rodef], and is liable with his life, and [therefore] he is subject only to the greater [penalty]! And one can answer: [The case is] where they are able to save him [the victim] by [injuring] one of his [the pursuer's] limbs, and so we say in [the chapter] Ben Sorer (Sanhedrin 74a):
